## Description

<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:BEGIN -->
Found while investigating opag's prefix-collision report (QCLI-155). quest migration backlog preview/apply always mints target ids as T-1, T-2, ... (src/application/migration/backlog-public.ts, previewInternal, ~line 183/191), regardless of the workspace's configured .quest/workspace.toml taskIdPrefix (QCLI in this repo). This repo's own dogfooded .quest/tasks/ has T-1.json and T-2.json sitting alongside a QCLI- scheme nothing else uses, which is direct evidence of the divergence. This may be an intentional design choice (a dedicated import namespace sidesteps ever needing cross-system id reconciliation, and is part of why case-only collisions with existing QCLI-N tasks are structurally impossible for the primary id -- only aliases can collide, and those are already guarded). Or it may be an oversight that leaves imported tasks permanently looking inconsistent with the rest of the project's numbering. This task is to make and record that call, not to implement a fix -- it needs a product decision from whoever owns migration UX before any code changes.
<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:END -->

## Acceptance Criteria
<!-- AC:BEGIN -->
- [ ] #1 A decision is recorded: keep the dedicated T- import namespace as-is, or change migration target-id minting to use the configured taskIdPrefix
- [ ] #2 If changed, the collision-safety property proven in QCLI-155 (refuse before write, case-folded) is preserved or re-verified under the new scheme
<!-- AC:END -->

implementationNotes: Decided (2026-09-07, fleet backlog campaign wave 0, opum-agent OPAG-64): already resolved and shipped -- this task was overtaken by QCLI-157 (PR #223, merged well before this campaign) before anyone read it as still open. Verified live in current source: BacklogImportService's taskIdPrefix flows from the CLI's configuredTaskIdPrefix() (src/cli/main.ts:~629, configuration.taskIdPrefix ?? "T") through to previewInternal (src/application/migration/backlog-public.ts:407-452, comment explicitly citing QCLI-157: "Targets the destination workspace's own configured taskIdPrefix... instead of a hardcoded 'T-'"). This repository's own .quest/workspace.toml has taskIdPrefix = "QCLI", and no T-*.json files remain anywhere under .quest/ (the stale evidence this task was filed against). The "T" default is only the fallback for a workspace that never configures one, not a hardcoded namespace. AC1: decision was to change migration target-id minting to use the configured prefix, and that shipped. AC2: collision safety is preserved under the new scheme -- the refuse-before-write, case-folded check (collectAliasCollisions, backlog-public.ts:365-374) sits on the same live code path, and test/e2e/migration/backlog-public.test.ts's "migration targets the workspace's configured taskIdPrefix and still guards organic numbering (QCLI-157)" proves both properties together end to end. No code change needed; this task closes on evidence, not new work.
finalSummary: Decided: migrated Backlog tasks already use the workspace's configured taskIdPrefix, not a hardcoded T- namespace. This was already implemented by QCLI-157 (PR #223) before this task was picked up in the fleet backlog campaign -- the divergence QCLI-156 was filed against no longer exists in current source. Verified live: the CLI resolves configuredTaskIdPrefix() from .quest/workspace.toml and threads it through BacklogImportService/previewInternal to target-id minting; this repository's own workspace.toml has taskIdPrefix = "QCLI" and carries no leftover T-*.json files. Collision safety (refuse before write, case-folded, proven in QCLI-155) sits on the same code path and is covered end to end by test/e2e/migration/backlog-public.test.ts's QCLI-157 test. No code change required.
